summary: Restoration and conservation pledges focus on Saint Lucia’s forestry sector, with forest covering 542 km², or 89.4% of the country’s land. Saint Lucia aims to increase land-based sequestration by 21 GgCO2 per year by 2030 and 33 GgCO2 per year by 2035 relative to 2010, with reforestation of degraded land contributing to the additional sink; in the restoration accounting, these gains are expressed as −21 and −33 GgCO2 per year. The 2035 sink-capacity target is also presented as a 33 GgCO2 enhancement. Agriculture measures focus on a Climate Resilient Agriculture Demonstration Centre that will enable vulnerable groups in three subsistence farming communities to become competitive agribusiness leaders under a changing climate. No agricultural area or reforestation hectares are specified, so neither commitment can be compared directly with the country’s 36 km² of agricultural land or its 542 km² of forest.
